partial_progress.details: Finished the remaining three phases of plan 08 (9.1, 9.2, 10), completing all 18 phases of the plan. Phase 9.1's outer fuel induction was the hard blocker carried from the prior dispatch: its Progress Record had drafted a List.Forall2-over-a-bundled-(e,acc,keys)-triple design and stalled on a base-case membership-transport argument. This dispatch instead designed a lighter existential 4-column threading relation (Ex4Inv, built from nested List.zip as zip4) licensed by the observation that S4RedirectSoundInv_step's own conclusion is already existential (guarantees only ONE child branch inherits the invariant per step, never all of them) -- so a universal relation was both harder to establish and strictly stronger than the argument needs. Landed sorry-free: S4KOFullInv, modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_newExps_eq_map (structural fact: a step's newExps/replicated newAcc/keys' columns are constant across newBs), zip4, mem_zip_of_mem_map_const, Ex4Inv_of_mem_const, zip4_append, Ex4Inv_embedLeft/embedRight, mem_zip4_proj13, zip4_cons_mem_cases, and the outer induction theorem modalExpandBranchesS4KeyedOrdered_closed_False (~285 lines total, FrameCompleteness.lean). Phase 9.2's capstone modalTableauS4KeyedOrdered_sound (~35 lines) compiled on the FIRST attempt, confirming the Phase 9 Scope Decision's 'thin corollary' estimate. Phase 10 added a permanent type-level regression witness row to CslibTests/S4LoopGuardRegression.lean (additive only -- git diff confirmed every pre-existing #guard_msgs row byte-identical) and ran the full 8-step CSLib CI pipeline end to end.
